turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are you doing right now?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I've got chicken thighs, a bag of spinach and some rice. The kids are hungry and I'm tired.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: You could do a quick garlic chicken and rice bowl, or a creamy spinach chicken in one pan. Which sounds better tonight?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can you hang on? I have to talk to someone here. I'll tell you when I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Ethan, do you want to do the raid tonight?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: What time? I've got work early tomorrow.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Like eight? It should only take a couple of hours.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Last time you said that we finished at one in the morning.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That was because the tank kept disconnecting. We've got a new one now.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Fine. Eight, and I'm out by ten whatever happens.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Deal. I'll send everyone a message.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sorry, that took a while. I'm back.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sure thing. We were picking dinner, the rice bowl or the creamy spinach chicken?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The rice bowl. The kids won't eat anything creamy with green bits in it.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Fair enough. Start the rice first, it takes about twenty minutes, and fry the chicken while it cooks.
